title: Ancient Civilizations Research Grant
shortDescription: Supporting archaeological fieldwork and historical research into ancient cultures.
description: This grant funds fieldwork and research for history and archaeology students. **Experience** in excavation sites or museum internships is crucial. **Career goals** should be academic or curatorial, focusing on preserving history. **Achievements** such as presenting at historical conferences or discovering significant artifacts are prized. **Extracurricular activities** like history club leadership or volunteering at heritage sites demonstrate commitment.
requirements: GPA 3.3+. **Experience** in archaeological methods. **Achievements** in historical research. **Extracurricular activities** related to cultural heritage. **Career goals** in archaeology or history education.
benefits: $8,000 for travel and equipment. **Benefits** include publication of your findings to boost your **career goals**. You will gain **experience** at a UNESCO World Heritage site. We showcase your **achievements** in our monthly archaeology digest.
